title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension.

HPI
Pt is an 87yF presenting for routine f/u of HTN. She reports feeling well overall. Denies any recent syncope, chest pain, or shortness of breath. Reports adherence to current meds. BP has been stable at home. No new concerns today.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 25mg daily
Aspirin 81mg daily

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 132/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6.
CV: RRR, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: CTAB.
Ext: No edema.
Neuro: NAD.

Assessment
1. Hypertension: Well-controlled on current regimen.

Plan
1. Continue current medications as prescribed.
2. Routine f/u in 3 months.
3. Return to clinic sooner if any acute symptoms develop.

Problem List
- major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate

Electronically signed,
R. Mensah, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: Depression appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
